name: Seohelpnow AI Blogger Tool
author: seohelpnow

sections.description:
Seohelpnow AI Blogger Tool combines four related WordPress capabilities:

  • AI Blogger — Receives authenticated article titles, formatted content, publication status, JSON-LD, and optional featured-image URLs from the connected Seohelpnow service.
  • Local SEO Blogger — Supports location-focused articles, FAQs, approved Google Maps and YouTube embeds, structured data, and rich formatting.
  • LLMs.txt and AI URL files — Generates /llms.txt and /ai-urls.txt locally from public WordPress content, without requiring a service connection.
  • IndexNow and Bing workflow — Manages the verification key used by the connected IndexNow workflow for Bing and other participating search engines. Indexing is not guaranteed.

The plugin connects WordPress to the LocalTrafficEngine publishing platform operated by Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions. Seohelpnow is the product website and WordPress companion experience.

Included Features

  • Authenticated REST publishing with validation and rate limiting.
  • Scoped sanitization for rich article formatting.
  • Approved HTTPS YouTube and Google Maps embeds.
  • Safe JSON-LD extraction, storage, and front-end output.
  • Optional featured-image downloads with type and size checks.
  • Local /ai-urls.txt and /llms.txt routes.
  • Authenticated IndexNow verification-key management.
  • Admin dashboard, connection health test, and feature-test draft.
  • About Service page with privacy, terms, ownership, and support details.
  • Suggested text in Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide.

How It Works

  1. Activate the plugin. /ai-urls.txt and /llms.txt become available.
  2. Review Seohelpnow AI → About Service.
  3. Open SaaS Connection when ready to connect.
  4. Paste a connection key generated by the Seohelpnow service.
  5. Run the API health test and optional feature-test draft.

Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions uses smart data, practical SEO and AEO strategies, and creative marketing to help businesses improve online discovery and attract relevant audiences. The plugin does not guarantee traffic, rankings, citations, or indexing.

External Services

This plugin can connect to the LocalTrafficEngine platform operated by Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions. Local /ai-urls.txt and /llms.txt generation does not require a connection.

Site connection

The plugin does not contact LocalTrafficEngine until an administrator submits a connection key or uses a connected feature.

During connection, the plugin sends:

  • The administrator-provided connection key.
  • The WordPress site URL and home URL.
  • The REST publishing endpoint URL.
  • The installed plugin version.

Connection endpoint:

https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/api/connect_plugin.php

The service returns a publish token. It is stored in the WordPress database and authenticates later publishing and IndexNow requests.

AI and local SEO publishing

After connection, the service may send:

  • Article title and formatted HTML content.
  • Requested publication status.
  • JSON-LD structured data.
  • An optional featured-image URL.
  • The authentication token.

Publishing endpoint:

/wp-json/localtrafficengine/v1/receive-blog

When an image URL is supplied, the WordPress server contacts that third-party host. The host may receive the server IP address and standard HTTP request metadata.

IndexNow and Bing workflow

The service may send an IndexNow verification key to:

/wp-json/localtrafficengine/v1/upload-key

The request must include the stored publish token. The plugin writes or rotates the key only when WordPress has non-interactive direct filesystem access. The external service handles URL-submission activity. Search engines independently decide whether and when to crawl or index a URL.

Service information

  • Service provider: Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions
  • Seohelpnow website: https://seohelpnow.com/
  • LocalTrafficEngine platform: https://localtrafficengine.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/terms.php
  • Privacy Policy: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/privacy.php
  • Support and privacy contact: antonio@seohelpnow.com

The About Service page also links to optional external trial and SEO-audit pages. No payment is collected by this plugin. The REST namespace localtrafficengine/v1 is retained for compatibility with existing connected campaigns.

Privacy

When related features are used, the plugin stores:

  • Connection status and publishing authentication token.
  • Plugin version and welcome-notice preference.
  • The managed IndexNow key name.
  • Temporary authentication rate-limit records.
  • JSON-LD metadata associated with service-created posts.

Service-delivered articles are stored as WordPress posts. Downloaded images are stored in the media library. Posts and media remain after disconnection or uninstall unless an administrator removes them.

Data handled by the connected platform is governed by:

  • Privacy Policy: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/privacy.php
  • Terms of Service: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/terms.php

The plugin adds suggested disclosure wording to Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide. Site owners should review and adapt it. Privacy questions may be sent to antonio@seohelpnow.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seohelpnow-ai-blogger-tool folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen.
  3. Visit Seohelpnow AI in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review About Service and connect only when ready to use remote publishing.
sections.faq:
Is this only an LLMs.txt plugin?

No. It also supports authenticated AI blog publishing, local SEO article workflows, AI URL generation, JSON-LD, approved embeds, optional images, and IndexNow key management.

Which features work without a service account?

/ai-urls.txt, /llms.txt, the local dashboard, public-file routes, and feature-test tools. Remote article delivery and service-managed IndexNow requests require a connection.

Are arbitrary scripts or iframe hosts allowed?

No. Executable scripts are removed. Valid JSON-LD is stored separately. Iframes are limited to approved HTTPS YouTube and Google Maps embed URLs.

Does IndexNow guarantee Bing indexing?

No. The plugin manages a verification key for the connected workflow. Search engines decide whether and when to crawl or index a URL.

What happens when I disconnect?

The publish token is removed and future authenticated service requests are disabled. Existing posts, media, /ai-urls.txt, and /llms.txt remain.

What happens on uninstall?

Plugin options, rate-limit transients, the managed key file when accessible, and plugin-created JSON-LD metadata are removed. Published posts and media are retained.

How do I get support?

Email antonio@seohelpnow.com or visit https://seohelpnow.com/.

1.0.24

  • Rewrote the readme around AI Blogger, Local SEO Blogger, LLMs.txt, AI URL, and IndexNow/Bing workflow features.
  • Added an About Service page identifying Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions, Seohelpnow, and LocalTrafficEngine.
  • Added the exact Terms, Privacy Policy, and antonio@seohelpnow.com support details.
  • Added WordPress Privacy Policy Guide content.
  • Clarified that IndexNow does not guarantee traffic, rankings, crawling, or indexing.

1.0.23

  • Fixed the Google Maps feature-test URL and rejected invalid or truncated Maps embed URLs.

1.0.22

  • Restored approved iframe sanitization and local feature-test draft creation.
  • Preserved approved YouTube and Google Maps embeds as validated shortcodes.

1.0.21

  • Restored dashboard, connection, About/Services, and feature-test functionality while retaining security protections.

1.0.20

  • Added REST validation, rate limiting, image limits, IndexNow hardening, PHP compatibility, and uninstall cleanup.

1.0.17

  • Original dashboard, URL files, IndexNow endpoint, connection, publishing endpoint, and service pages.
